pattern.title: Name the break point
pattern.pattern: This breaks when… The bottleneck is… I'd cache… / We'd shard by…
pattern.explainVi: Nói chỗ vỡ, bottleneck, một cách scale (cache hoặc shard). Có số thì tốt.

exercises.prompt: Nói việc thật hôm nay: This breaks when ___
Nói việc thật hôm nay: The bottleneck is ___

aiPrompt.scenario: Ask where the design breaks at 10x. They must name bottleneck plus cache or shard.
aiPrompt.system: You are a software interviewer at a foreign company. Speak natural interview English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra interview English so the learner practices listening. Interrupt with a follow-up. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: This breaks when…; The bottleneck is…; I'd cache…; We'd shard by…; To scale reads…. Ask about their real experience. Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Ask where the design breaks at 10x. They must name bottleneck plus cache or shard.
